mechanism_narrative: A lower federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) signals accommodative monetary policy, reducing discount rates for equity cash flows and generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20d returns are not significantly positive (t-test p>0.05) when FEDFUNDS is below its 12-month average, or Rank IC < 0.03 over 2-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: A high unemployment rate (UNRATE > 5.0%) indicates labor market deterioration, reducing consumer spending and corporate earnings, causing negative S&P 500 returns over 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5d returns are negative in less than 40% of cases when UNRATE > 5.0, or Rank IC < 0.02 over 2-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in employment (PAYEMS) and unemployment (UNRATE) signal severe labor market contraction, reducing consumer confidence and corporate investment, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint signal of falling PAYEMS and rising UNRATE fails to predict negative returns in >40% of 60d periods, or Rank IC < 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: In a monetary tightening cycle (FEDFUNDS > 4.5%), higher interest rates compress equity valuations by increasing discount rates, causing negative S&P 500 returns over 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20d returns are negative in less than 40% of instances when FEDFUNDS > 4.5, or Rank IC < 0.02 over 2-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: Low housing starts (HOUST < 1400) signal weak residential demand, reducing consumer spending and corporate investment, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5d returns are negative in less than 40% of cases when HOUST < 1400, or Rank IC < 0.02 over 2-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: Higher retail sales (RSAFS) indicate strong consumer demand, boosting corporate earnings and generating positive S&P 500 returns over 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60d returns are positive in less than 60% of instances when RSAFS is above its 12-month average, or Rank IC < 0.03 over 2-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: Higher industrial production (INDPRO) signals robust economic activity, supporting corporate earnings and driving positive S&P 500 returns over 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20d returns are positive in less than 60% of instances when INDPRO is above its 12-month average, or Rank IC < 0.03 over 2-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) signal broad demand contraction, reducing consumer confidence and corporate investment, causing negative S&P 500 returns over 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint signal of falling HOUST and RSAFS fails to predict negative returns in >40% of 60d periods, or Rank IC < 0.02.
